lines.zh: 苔藓这么滑，我一路溜下坡。
lines.en: The moss is so slick I slide all the way downhill.
A slope is my best friend.
Rolling downhill, I count my own turns.
Unfold once, then curl back up.
I hit the step and bounced once.
Grass flattens beneath me as I pass.

lines.zh: 我滚过小路，留下一道痕。
lines.en: I roll across the path, leaving a groove.

lines.zh: 方向不对，我又滚回来了。
lines.en: Wrong way; I roll right back.
Rolling on my shell saves my feet.

lines.zh: 前面的坡看起来很好玩。
lines.en: That slope ahead looks like fun.
I creep forward one turn at a time.
Unfold to check, ah, still a dirt path.
One gust of wind and I drift off course.
Rolling this long has made me dizzy.
On stones I bounce higher.

lines.zh: 我顺着田埂一路滚过去。
lines.en: I roll all the way along the ridge.
I pull myself into a perfect ball.
When I unfold, my limbs feel stiff.
I stop after the eighth spin.
I am waiting for a favorable wind.
Last year's mud still clings to my shell.

lines.zh: 有人从旁边走过去了吗？
lines.en: Did someone just walk past me?
Curled tight, I am safe.

lines.zh: 我试着用一条缝看世界。
lines.en: I peek at the world through one seam.
Once unfolded, my belly feels empty.
I roll into the shade to cool off.

lines.zh: 背上这道划痕是哪来的？
lines.en: Where did this scratch on my back come from?

lines.zh: 一动不动时，我像块石头。
lines.en: When I hold still, I look like a stone.
This shell is my house.
I want one more roll, just one.
I am waiting for a slope that goes down.
A blade of grass slips into my seam.
Have you come to kick a ball?
I unfold a little and look at you.
Do not mistake me for a stone.
One push and I roll a long way.
I can see you through my seam too.
Your shadow falls on me; it is cooler.
I roll to your feet; are you afraid?
From down here, you look very tall.

lines.zh: 我的刷怪蛋是我唯一带的。
lines.en: My spawn egg is all I carry.
No loot, really. Do not rummage.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我就滚过去。
lines.en: If you stand still, I will roll over.

lines.zh: 要不要看我怎么收起来？
lines.en: Want to see how I fold away?
Ow, a crack opened in my shell.
Hit me if you must, but not the shell.
I curled too tight and cannot breathe.
That blow scattered me out of shape.
I roll aside to collect myself.
The shell is hard; the inside is soft.

lines.zh: 壳缝里渗出汁，我卷不圆了。
lines.en: Sap seeps through the crack; I can no longer roll up round.
Do not chase; I cannot roll fast now.
Wind leaks through the crack; it is cold.

lines.zh: 我得找个地方展开检查。
lines.en: I need somewhere to unfold and check.

lines.zh: 那是什么？闻起来是甜的。
lines.en: What is that? It smells sweet.

lines.zh: 我滚过来，是因为你在摇它。
lines.en: I rolled over because you waved it.
Give me a little and I will unfold.
I cannot reach; I need to roll closer.
Hold it and I will circle you.
The smell slips in through my seam.
I spun too fast and lost sight of it.

lines.zh: 别吊着我，我可是会滚的。
lines.en: Do not dangle it; I can roll, you know.
If I bump you, blame the scent.
The sweetness makes me forget directions.
Step back; I will roll over and take it.
My mouth is inside; I must unfold.
That bite is worth one long roll.
I rolled sideways; let me try again.

lines.zh: 你把果子放地上，我自己滚过去。
lines.en: Set the fruit down; I will roll over myself.

lines.zh: 香味从壳缝里一直钻到脚。
lines.en: The smell seeps through my seam down to my feet.
I hit you and spin in place.
I am not a ball, but close enough.

lines.zh: 弹开了，你的膝盖没事吧？
lines.en: I bounced off; is your knee all right?
Please do not block me with your foot.
That collision rolled me rather far.

lines.zh: 我收起壳了，再撞也不疼。
lines.en: Shell closed, so bumping hurts less.

lines.zh: 你踢我一脚，我弹进沟里。
lines.en: One kick from you and I bounce into the ditch.
Two round things have collided.
You stand like a wall and I rebound.
Make way; I cannot stop rolling.
Do we have to roll into each other?
Two balls touch, and that is that.
I am so nervous I curled into a ball.
Do not push; I will roll there myself.
We should roll toward the same slope.
Your shell has a lovely color.
Slow down; I get dizzy quickly.
Rolling together means we will collide.

lines.zh: 我在你旁边展开了一点点。
lines.en: I unfolded a little beside you.
This turn, I rolled it for you.
I pin it down with my shell.

lines.zh: 捡不起来，只能滚着带走。
lines.en: I cannot lift it; I will roll it along.
Will this fit into my seam?
I hide it underneath myself.
I unfold one limb to reach it.

lines.zh: 掉的东西归滚得快的人。
lines.en: Dropped things belong to the faster roller.
I crushed it. Sorry about that.
I am keeping this shiny stone.
Holding it, I can no longer roll.
Do not grab it; I rolled here first.

lines.zh: 那个滚动的影子是什么？
lines.en: What is that rolling shadow?
Something rolled onto my slope.
Let me spin twice to see clearly.
It rolls too; I want to race it.
I unfold and lower my weight.
Footsteps are coming from the right.
That round stone just moved.
My shell is aimed at it.
It has taken my downhill path.
I decide to roll over and ask.
Three rolls away; perfect distance.

lines.zh: 我算着它下一次往哪滚。
lines.en: I am guessing where it rolls next.
The moment it moves, I speed up.
The grass is blocking my view.
Steady; do not unfold too early.
I roll over, then unfold.
Down this slope, I can catch it.

lines.zh: 它踩碎一片枯叶，方位就露了。
lines.en: It crushes a dry leaf, and its position is revealed.
The seam of my shell faces it.

lines.zh: 我贴着地滚到它侧后方。
lines.en: I roll low along the ground to its flank.

lines.zh: 展开的时候，我比石头大。
lines.en: Unfurled, I'm bigger than a boulder.

lines.zh: 滚起来，重量就不一样了。
lines.en: Once rolling, my weight changes everything.
After the hit I spun half a turn.

lines.zh: 我展开来，比你想象的宽。
lines.en: Unfold me and I'm wider than you think.
My shell is fine; it may not be.
That roll landed exactly right.
Unfold, bite, then curl up again.
I cut across with my shell rim.
It retreated; I am still rolling.
Do not block me; my speed will not stop.
I roll out of the egg.

lines.zh: 落地第一件事，就是转圈。
lines.en: My first act on landing is a spin.
The spawn egg splits; my shell comes first.
I have not learned how to stop.
This slope is steeper than I expected.
Just born, and I already hit a tree.
I unfold to look around.

lines.zh: 蛋壳还挂在背上，我先滚半圈。
lines.en: My eggshell still clings to my back, so I roll half a turn.
A new place calls for a new roll.
I hear rolling somewhere in the distance.
My shell is burning hot to the touch.

lines.zh: 从高处滚下来，我散架了。
lines.en: Rolling off a height knocked me apart.

lines.zh: 我沉下去了，壳里进了水。
lines.en: I sank, and water got inside my shell.
The blast rolled me a long way off.

lines.zh: 有个尖东西卡进我的缝。
lines.en: Something sharp is stuck in my seam.

lines.zh: 光一照，我的壳变得很轻。
lines.en: The light made my shell feel weightless.

lines.zh: 饿得我连滚的力气都没了。
lines.en: Too hungry to roll with any force.
One bolt, and my shell went numb.

lines.zh: 我在往下掉，没有地面可滚。
lines.en: I am falling, with no ground to roll on.
